title: interp1q

gpu_support.notes: gpuArray inputs are gathered to the CPU linear interpolation implementation.

description: `interp1q(X,V,Xq)` is the legacy quick form of one-dimensional linear interpolation. It uses strictly increasing sample points and returns `NaN` for out-of-range query points.
behaviors: Accepts exactly three inputs: sample locations `X`, sample values `V`, and query locations `Xq`.
`X` must be a finite strictly increasing vector with at least two points.
`V` must be real numeric data compatible with `X` using the same sample-dimension rules as `interp1`.
Vector-valued queries preserve scalar versus array shape for vector `V`; matrix `V` returns `numel(Xq)` by trailing-series dimensions.
Only linear interpolation is supported, matching the legacy quick-interpolation API.
Complex interpolation inputs are not yet supported by RunMat's shared interpolation engine.
